title: 'git vouch check': compute tiers and validate registry
description: Walk the registry: validate and verify every record, load anchors.json, compute each person's tier. Approver must sit above granted tier; automation granted only by maintainer/anchor and can approve/endorse nobody. Revoked approver/endorser key voids its records; retired keys keep earlier records. Report every problem; non-zero exit on any.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture registries cover: valid tree, self-promotion attempt, approver below tier, automation approving, revoked approver voiding tiers, retired endorser key still valid, revocation by anchor and by other own key.
notes:
Decided 2026-10-22 (Mark): any registered human (non-automation person file) may endorse, with or without a tier. Endorsement validity = valid signature by a current/unrevoked key of a registered non-automation person. See DESIGN.md 'Any registered human may endorse'.
DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22) D6: approver steps down (tier record deleted/lowered, or removed from anchors.json, not compromised): tiers they granted stay valid. Authority is judged at the commit that added the tier record (git history, per metarule). Only a revoked key voids what it signed. Current code hard-fails check in this case (git-vouch:967-972) - must change to: valid if the approver held authority when the record was committed.
